A minified package.json stays on one line.
-- changes --
[{"name":"semver","ecosystem":"npm","to":"7.7.2","method":"override","file":"package.json"}]
-- in:package.json nonl --
{"name":"app","dependencies":{"express":"^4.18.0"}}
-- out:package.json nonl --
{"name":"app","dependencies":{"express":"^4.18.0"},"overrides":{"semver":"7.7.2"}}
